profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Aumovio
profile.summary:
I am an electronics engineer with more than five years experience. I have participated in various development projects as a design engineer in R&D sector, I have performed different activities like software and firmware development, testing, etc. I have a little experience in embedded automotive applications, and electronics circuit failure analysis. I have experience working with agile methodologies such as SCRUM. I'm interested in Research and Development, Computer Vision, Embedded Systems, Linux, Internet of Things.
I’m truly passionate about my work and always eager to connect with other people. I’m always interested in hearing from former colleagues, managers, or just interesting creative folk, so feel free to contact me if you’d like to connect. 
Programming languages: C, C++.
OS: Unix (Mac OS X), Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS), Embedded Linux, Windows.
Microcontrollers: Freescale Kinetis, TI DSP, Atmel SAM5dx, MicroBlaze Soft-core.
Protocols: CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART.
Web: PHP, HTML, CSS.
Database: SQLite
IDEs: Xilinx ISE SDK, Xcode, CodeWarrior, Eclipse.
Others: OpenCV, Yocto, Buildroot, Bash, Mercurial, Git, Bugzilla.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Full Programmable Cluster (FPC) group - VNI CVS. C/C++ software development for embedded Linux Platform. Code debugging and testing. Bug/Issue fixing.
HW/SW Integration activities: bring up of boards, reading schematics, working at low level stuff like bootloaders, flashers, DTS. Kernel version upgrade for 2 products.
An active Embedded SW Engineer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of Linux Embedded Automotive Platform (LEAP) group - VNI CVS. 
C/C++ software development for embedded Linux Platform. Code debugging and testing. Bug/Issue fixing.
HW/SW Integration activities: bring up of boards, reading schematics, working at low level stuff like bootloaders, flashers, DTS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android OS System Engineer at Open Source Technology Center (SSG).
Android OS System Debug for OEM Platforms.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Firmware Engineer at the Research and Development (R&D) Division, part of Engineering Solutions Team.
PXI Automotive Series Products: Developed firmware for PXI CAN/LIN Boards, using C language. The system were MicroBlaze (Xilinx FPGA 32-bit RISC soft processor) based. Performed hardware/software integration and debug, together with other hardware/software engineers. Documented and reviewed code and software design procedures.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
CTS services include: ASIC design, System design, PCB design, Firmware, Consulting.
CTS has a large experience designing for companies such as: IBM, HP, AT&T, Paradyne, SIEMENS, 3M, Transwich, Dantel, XEROX, and other small companies.

• SMS Server: Web development, C/C++ software development for embedded Linux system. Involved as a team member in the whole project life cycle. Wrote component-level Software Design Document Specification.
http://www.cts-design.com/html/servidordemensajes.html
• PHP/C/C++ Software testing. Wrote component-level test plan for acceptance of developed software. Installed, configured and maintained Linux server’s tools, and custom repositories.
• CIU: Writing a Hardware Technical Document Specification. Performed research Touch Sensing and Audio support by Frescale Kinetis Microcontroller.
http://www.cts-design.com/html/ciu-esp.html
• Passenger counter using video camera. Perfomed research algorithms and techniques for bidirectional counting of people. C Firmware development and testing (TI DSP).
http://www.cts-design.com/html/contador.html

company.name: Centro de Tecnología en Semiconductores - CTS

positions.title: Field Service Engineer
positions.description:
• Installing, testing and calibrating gas and liquid measurement equipment, pressure and temperature sensors, liquid measurement systems, flow meters, flow computers, monitoring systems and laboratory equipment.
• Installing and operating S600 flow measurement computers. Help train the customer's employees on how to use the equipment.
• Supervising structured cabling network projects.

positions.title: Network Assistant Technician
positions.description:
• Maintaining and monitoring of internal structured cabling network.
• Preventive and corrective maintenance of electronic equipment.
• Developing and maintaining organization's website. 
• Involved in design and carrying out of internal optical fiber network.
